title: SDK and launcher must not add fingerprint changes
preconditions: CDP traffic between the automation client and the engine is observable
the engine process command line is readable

invariants.rule: The SDK must not send Runtime.enable
The SDK must not enable Debugger or Log domains
The SDK must not inject script before document load
The SDK must not override identity through Emulation
The engine command line must not contain automation or stealth flags added by the SDK
The SDK must not pass proxy credentials or the license key on the command line
The engine command line must not contain a user-agent override added by the SDK
The CDP debug port must bind to loopback only
navigator.webdriver must be false in the launched profile
The SDK helper world must not be visible as a page global
The SDK must not disable the Chromium sandbox without an explicit user opt-in
invariants.unless: explicit args entry on a container host

invariants.rule: binary_info() must report a verified binary before launch
